column1: # Not applied to config/ram: the orchestrator reconciles.  'replaces X' = the current generic name.

# Deliberately NOT proposed here (already proposed by other groups or bank-dependent addresses): C1DD/C1DE (wMobileResultCode/Detail, ram_g2), C267/C268/C26D/C26E/C26F/C2D5/C2D6 timers (ram_g2/g7), C2C1 (wHtmlFlags, g8), C2C3 (wCommSessionKind, g7), C2CC (g7), C2AD/C2AE (wKeyboardCharLo/Hi, g3/g4), FFE1-FFEF (g8); FFD6/FFD7 (Retracted: hImageWidth/hImageHeight; the BMP width/height of 51:70F4 is also used as a small scratch counter by bank 74 list/layout code, so no name is proposed); C2EE/C2EF is shared with wTextCellsLeft (g2/g3); WRAM bank 7 $D800-$D9FF palette buffers and SRAM bank 1 $A9E4-$AFFF / $BF05 are described in docs/research/naming_g5.md only (banked addresses).

column6: evidence

replaces wRam_C1D2..C1D7: the BC, DE, HL (three words) of the running SDK task saved by Http_StartGet/Post (54:4288/42FB: BC size, DE buffer, HL URL), Pop3_StartTop/Dele (HL message, C1D2 = C mode) and Mobile_BeginConnect (C1D2 = C)

replaces wRam_C1D8: 0 = no task; set to 1/3/7 by every Start routine of bank 54 (3 = HTTP POST / connect with dial slot, 7 = GET after a redirect) and cleared by the matching poll when it finishes (54:4135, 41B7, 4532, 4569...)
replaces wRam_C1D9: zeroed by every Start routine, incremented (inc [hl] ; dec a ; jr z chains) by the poll routines 54:405D, 4772, 489B, 4CF4 to select the sequencer step; 4176/4895 pre-set it to 2
replaces wRam_C1DA: 0 by Mobile_ResetCommandTimer; set to 1 by Mobile_CheckTimeout (54:44C3) when it issued MobileAPI $3C after the 5-minute timeout, so later polls report error $26
replaces wRam_C1DB: 3 written by every Start routine; Http_Poll (54:4393) refuses to follow a redirect when it is 0 and decrements it otherwise
replaces wRam_C1E0: filled by MobileAPI $0E (login id, max $21 bytes, DE=$C1E0, 54:4086); used as the 2nd string of the API $06 connect block (54:4102) and of the HTTP request block (54:42C0)
replaces wRam_C201: filled by MobileAPI $10 (e-mail address, max $1F, DE=$C201, 54:4094); used as HL of Smtp_StartHelo (54:44FE) and as the account of the POP3 login block (54:485C)

replaces wRam_C220: set by Mobile_BeginConnect (54:4141 copies its HL there); 3rd string of the API $06 connect block (54:4102), 2nd string of the POP3 login block (54:4870) and of the HTTP request block (54:42CA)
replaces wRam_C25D: status of Pop3_RetrPoll/Function_54_50FC: 0 ok, 1 unreadable message (54:4FA4), 2 text clamped with an ellipsis (54:50FC, 4D9C); returned in B by the last RETR poll (54:4D2E)
replaces wRam_C284: pixel Y of the highlighted cell computed by Kbd_UpdateCursorSprite (55:61F6) and copied to sprite slot 11 (wSpriteSlots+176) by Kbd_DrawGlyphPreview; C285 = X
replaces wRam_C285: pixel X of the highlighted cell (Kbd_UpdateCursorSprite), copied to wSpriteSlots+177
replaces wRam_C2AB: keyboard type 0-10 (A of Kbd_Open); indexes Table_Kbd_PagePointers, Table_Kbd_NeighbourRecords, Table_Kbd_OkCell and 8 property tables; 40+ sites, only bank 55 uses it

replaces wRam_C2AC: current page 0-3 of the keyboard (the Select handler Label_55_5E02 adds 1 mod 4 on types with pages; selects the page pointer in Kbd_FetchCell and the graphics in Kbd_LoadPageGraphics)
replaces wRam_C2AF: B of Kbd_Open (0 slide in inside Kbd_Run, 2 shown at once); Kbd_Run sets 1, Kbd_Hide/6559 sets 0
replaces wRam_C2B2: set by Kbd_RequestGlyphRedraw, cleared by Kbd_DrawGlyphPreview after it drew the glyph of the highlighted cell
replaces wRam_C2B5: current cursor cell index = row*18 + column (Kbd_SplitCursorIndex / Kbd_ColRowToIndex); start value from Table_Kbd_StartCell
replaces wRam_C2B9: direction of the current move (0 left, 1 right, 2 up, 3 down) stored by Kbd_MoveCursor and used to pick the handler in 55:6068 and Table_55_5FC8
replaces wRam_C2BA: column 0-17 of C2B5 written by Kbd_SplitCursorIndex (55:6149) and used to place the cursor sprite
replaces wRam_C2BB: row of C2B5 (index div 18) written by Kbd_SplitCursorIndex, y = row*16 + base in Kbd_UpdateCursorSprite
replaces wRam_C2BC: choice 0-2 of the type-10 picker (Kbd_TypePickerLoop), loaded from / saved to SRAM bank1 $BF05 by Kbd_LoadInputMode/Kbd_SaveInputMode; indexes Data_55_65D7 (keyboard type 4/5/6)
replaces wRam_C2BD: remembered column ($FF none) set from C2BA by 55:60D3 when the neighbour record flags ask for it and used by 55:5FD0 to keep the column on vertical moves
replaces wRam_C2BE: remembered row ($FF none) set from C2BB by 55:60DA, used by 55:5FD0 to keep the row on horizontal moves

replaces wRam_C2C0: only reader is the scrollbar code 4E:5E11/5E5B (return at once when 0); written $FF by the page-view starts 4E:488D/48CB/493B and 4C:4F56, 0 by 4E:48CB first and by mail/settings code (22,23,24,27,7F) before the summary screen

replaces wRam_C2C2: index (& $7F) into Table_Browser_FrameDescriptors (21 sites in 4E): 0 CGI/settings pages, 1 browser pages, 2 mobile-dictionary pages; loaded from SRAM A9EF by Browser_BeginSession, then overwritten by 48CB/488D/4C:4F56
replaces wRam_C2C7/C2C8: cursor in the SRAM page buffer ($B000..) where the next reply/image is stored, updated by 4C:4840 and 4C:43CD; C2C9 = its SRAM bank (3)
replaces wRam_C2C9: SRAM bank of the receive cursor C2C7 (always 3, set by 4C:43CD and 4C:4840)

replaces wRam_C2CA: result of Browser_LoadPage (0 show page, 1-2 leave, 3-6 error classes from Browser_MapErrorToResult), consumed by JumpTableInline in 4E (Table_4E_4993 etc.) and read by bank 67 after CGI fetches
replaces wRam_C2CB: 1 while Browser_LoadPage runs (set by 4E:4962 before, cleared after); tested at 4C:41A8 to pick the abort path

replaces wRam_C2D1: set 1 after a successful connect (4C:43C2), cleared by Mobile_FetchResult unless the SDK code is $3x/$20/$21/$24/$26, by Comm_Disconnect and at boot (65:4000, 68:4A0F); no reader found (write-only in the disassembly), so the role is inferred from the writes
replaces wRam_C2D2: seconds value last drawn by Browser_DrawCommTimer ($FF = none); compared with FFB1 to toggle C2D3 (Browser_DrawCommTimer)

replaces wRam_C2D3: toggled ($FF xor) whenever the displayed seconds change (Browser_DrawCommTimer); both branches of the following test draw identical sprites, so it has no visible effect; reset with C2D2 at 4E:6196/6291

replaces wRam_C2D8..C2DB: accumulated connection time (frames, seconds, minutes, +1) stored by CommTime_ShowSummary (51:4000), mirrored to SRAM bank1 A9F8..A9FB, added to timer A by CommTime_AddTimerA, cleared by CommTime_Reset
replaces wRam_C2DD: entries (0-6) in the mobile-dictionary page history at WRAM bank 6 $DA00 ($80 B each): MobileDictView_HistoryPush/Pop (4C:5274/52A8)
replaces wRam_C2DE: ring index (0-5) of the mobile-dictionary page history, incremented mod 6 by MobileDictView_HistoryPush, decremented by MobileDictView_HistoryPop
replaces wRam_C2ED: range of a fade: 0 and 4-7 all 64 colours, 1 BG only, 2 OBJ only, 3 one OBJ palette; index of Table_4F_4194 / Table_4F_4233 (4F:418E, 422D); always 0 in executed code
replaces wRam_C2F0/C2F1: fade position 0..$0100 (lo, hi): PalFade_Start sets 0 or $0100 (bit7 of the step), PalFade_Step moves it by C2F2; $D980.. copies of it drive PalFade_BlendColor
replaces wRam_C2F2: signed per-frame step ($20 out, $E0 in, $10/$F0 slow); 0 = no fade (PalFade_Step returns Z); cleared by PalFade_Step at the end

replaces wRam_C334: 1 when Browser_LoadPage is called for link/back/menu navigation (4E:4B0E, 4E:4E17), 0 for a fresh start; when set 4C:4291 pushes the previous page onto history and cache; bank 51 Bmp_ConvertToTiles reuses it as scratch (bytes per bitmap row)

replaces hRam_FFDE: id of the highlighted link element (0 none, $FF invalid); used by 4E:4B0E (follow), 4C:501E, 4E:56DB/5716 (select), 4E:58DB (highlight style); FFDF holds the previous value (also 74)
replaces hRam_FFE9/FFEA: extra Y offset added to element coordinates while a strip is redrawn ($54 during 4E:53D1, else 0; cleared by Browser_SetScroll)
